svg.desc: Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Circuit_Yas-Island.svg; creator: Arz; Sentoan; Cherkash (cleanup); license: CC-BY-SA-3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/). PitPitch adaptation: isolate exact original route path, omit all labels, numbers, pit lanes, sector colours and background, recolour black and crop empty margin. Derivative distributed under CC-BY-SA-3.0. Original SHA-256: 45fdbc5ddc5aa0b23476bdcb7cfb1eedcb89c4474d6a336b4f59cd42ebd53a2b.
Authentic source transforms applied; proportionally sampled route with subpixel curve tolerance; uniform black double contour with transparent center and background; no labels.
